coastal.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 17
coastal.description: The mayor of Summerland, B.C., says that damage assessments have been completed as more of his community's residents return, after being forced to flee due to the out-of-control Bald Range wildfire.

kamloops.title: Summerland residents begin returning home as roughly 1,200 properties cleared for re-entry
kamloops.description: After more than a week, some Summerland residents are finally walking back through their front doors.

prince-george.title: How studying driver behaviour could make wildfire evacuations in northern B.C. safer
prince-george.description: A UNBC PhD candidate is studying how drivers respond during simulated wildfire evacuations on Highway 97 north of Prince George. The research will help build a traffic model that could help emergency planners understand congestion, travel times and road closures before an evacuation happens.

cariboo.title: Hatchery tours in Vanderhoof, B.C., offer rare chance to see this critically endangered fish
cariboo.description: Getting a glimpse of an endangered prehistoric fish is easier than you might think.

all.title: Historic Cumberland building goes up in flames
all.description: Chief Michael Williamson said they were alerted to the fire when people heard the alarms ringing and called in Courtenay firefighters to help.

all.title: Meteorologists are forecasting a 'super' El Niño. What does that mean for B.C.?
all.description: The El Niño weather pattern can affect temperature and precipitation across North America, but what does it mean for British Columbia? And will it affect the wildfire situation?

all.title: Where do Canada-U.S. trade negotiations stand? Here's a sector-by-sector breakdown
all.description: Canada is continuing to negotiate a trade deal with the U.S. that will allow it to both avoid U.S. President Donald Trump's crippling tariff threat — set to come into effect on Wednesday — and get some additional relief on existing tariffs in key sectors.

all.title: B.C. farmer who fled wildfire teams up with chef on sauces to support other producers
all.description: A B.C. chef and a local farmer who lost his home to the raging Bald Range wildfire have teamed up on a project to support other producers hit hard by fires this summer.

all.title: As wildfires destroy homes, should B.C. make FireSmart principles mandatory?
all.description: Experts say practical measures to keep your home from catching fire are proven to work — and point to the communities have built back smarter.

all.title: Homes across B.C. have been decimated by wildfires. Here's what to know about your insurance
all.description: Hundreds of structures have been lost to wildfires so far this year.  Experts say even those who are fully insured will face a long, complex process as they begin to rebuild.

all.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 15
all.description: Thousands of residents forced to flee their homes due to wildfires across B.C. are returning Saturday, and a major highway is set to reopen as some conditions improve.
